gcCorrection.scope: matching observed V8 base tag13.0.245.25, not an audit of every Electron patch
gcCorrection.finding: CDP HeapProfiler.startSampling sets kSamplingForceGC; GetAllocationProfile follows a CollectAllGarbage path. Absence of an explicit HeapProfiler.collectGarbage command does not establish absence of GC.
gcCorrection.consequence: The historical no-GC test label was too broad. Raw logs remain unchanged; sampled formal success is diagnostic only and cannot replace normal unprofiled acceptance.
